worldcombat.skill.aerialace.summary: Skim around a nearby opponent, then turn into a returning slash. Adjust your approach to keep up with them; once the blade swings, they can still evade its path.
The returning slash deals about %1$s Flying contact damage, once per enemy.

Travel up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick. The blade reaches %3$s blocks beyond your body with a %4$s-block sweep width. Adjust the approach to a nearby opponent, then lock the return direction. Walls stop both movement and the blade.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.growth.0: At level %1$s, base blade power reaches %2$s and its agility multiplier reaches %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.growth.1: At level %1$s, base blade power reaches %2$s and travel distance reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.use.1: Move out of a frontal approach
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.use.2: Strike across the short returning edge
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.preference.s: On: a broader, lighter edge, slightly shorter travel, and longer windup and cooldown. Off: a narrower, heavier reverse cut.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of dashing. Larger values let it cut in from further.
Prefer a reachable flank when the foe is approaching the user.
On: the user may leave its post to dash at a target; off: it only strikes from where it stands.
